code: export function bubbleSort(a: readonly number[]): number[] { const arr = [...a]; for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { let swapped = false; for (let j = 0; j < arr.length - i - 1; j++) { if (arr[j] > arr[j + 1]) { [arr[j], arr[j + 1]] = [arr[j + 1], arr[j]]; swapped = true; } } if (!swapped) break; } return arr; }
name: bubbleSort
summary: Bubble sort - repeatedly swap adjacent out-of-order pairs, stopping early once a pass makes no swap. Harvested from base-studio-code's own algorithm-visualization gallery (src/features/algorithms/viz/examples/sorts.ts), where it is one of the real trace-programs the app derives its sort animations from.
